specs.title: sign in as the owner by email and keep the session
S2-4 #5: Add demo brands adds both; pressing it again adds nothing and says why
Find audiences adds labelled, simulated, removable segments
change the tone words and a don't rule, save, reload: the overview shows the change
messages appear beside the right field, and nothing is saved while any field is invalid
leaving by a link or the back button with unsaved changes asks first; staying keeps them
the back button can leave too, after asking
closing the tab with unsaved changes asks (the browser's own prompt)
saved changes, or none, leave without asking
every customer and order figure of a simulated brand says Simulated data
another workspace's brand id, or a malformed id, shows not found

suites.title: S2-3 #7: keyboard (layout and contrast are in design-system.spec.ts)

specs.title: every control on the brand screens is reachable with Tab and shows a focus ring
brand controls work with Enter and Space

suites.title: S2-5: the search box on the overview

specs.title: S2-5 #1: searching “lapsed” on Fernhollow shows the lapsed segment first, with its kind and source
an empty search and a search with no results say so
S2-5 #5: hostile searches show a normal empty or results state, never an error
S3-2 #1 and S3-3 #1, #3, #5, #7: brief, hand edit, revision, stale save and restore
S3-3 #2: a hand edit that removes every audience is refused and nothing is saved
the objective is checked: too short is refused with the reason
another workspace's campaign id, or a malformed one, shows not found
S5-4 #1 to #6: make creative, new picture, edit words, pick and discard, through the UI
S5-4 #6: every action on an ad is reachable by keyboard at 375 px
F-26 #1 to #4: ads made with an older kit say so; Redraw with current kit redraws one or all at no AI cost, with undo

suites.title: S2-1 #1 and #2: layout and contrast on every screen

specs.title: every screen fits 375px with no sideways scroll and passes AA contrast
every screen fits 1440px with no sideways scroll and passes AA contrast

suites.title: S2-1 #3: a dark operating system still gets the light theme

specs.title: every screen looks the same with the system set to dark
every control on home, runs and run detail is reachable with Tab and shows a focus ring
controls work with Enter and Space
with reduced motion the ring and toasts do not animate
a 300-character name and a <script> name render as wrapped plain text
no real brand or trademark appears on any screen or the component page
sample figures on the component page are labelled
F-6: the index lists only Soft machine, and A and B are gone
S1-6 #1: both screens fit 375px with no sideways scroll
S1-6 #1: both screens fit 1440px with no sideways scroll
S1-6 #2: text meets WCAG AA contrast in light and dark themes
S1-6 #3: every control does something
S1-6 #4: only the fictional brand appears, and data is labelled as sample
C7-2: the demo brand's languages, Translate on a picked ad, machine-translation badges and the German ad in every size
C7-2 #5: a brand with no German legal lines leaves German out, and the Languages bar says why

steps.title: A signed-off Fernhollow brief and its ads (simulated pictures)
Pick an ad: French, German and Spanish are all offered
Clear Fernhollow's German legal lines on its Languages page and save
C7-2.5: back on the campaign, German is left out and the reason shows beside Translate
Put Fernhollow's German back, with the legal lines written for the demo

specs.title: C7-3: the launch pack of four picked social ads in four languages downloads as one zip of 64 ads with its manifests

annotations.description: 64-ad demo pack: 16.3 s from click to complete download, 22.6 MB

stdout.text: [pack] 64-ad demo pack: 16.3 s from click to complete download, 22.6 MB

annotations.description: 64-ad demo pack: 16.3 s from click to complete download, 22.6 MB

specs.title: F-10: logo upload accepts SVG and PNG, refuses hostile files with the reason, and removes
S5-3 Q7: the brand page says which open font draws each brand font
S4-3: refresh market notes, see their sources and dates, and confirm a second refresh within a day
F-12 #1 malformed ids answer 404
F-12 #2 a well-formed id that isn't in the workspace shows not found and is not indexed
start a run, approve a tagline, see the completed trail
rejecting ends the run as Rejected
a hostile brand name is shown as text, never run as markup
another workspace's run id shows not found
F-27 #1 and #2: a brief with two audiences gets 24 social ads grouped by audience, and New words on the second redraws only its ads

steps.title: Write a Quillmoor brief with the mock Brief agent (one audience)
F-27.4: sign version 1 off and note the cost on Make creative with one audience
Add a second audience to the brief and sign version 2 off
F-27.4: with two audiences, the cost on Make creative is unchanged (pictures are shared, the words are one Copy run)
F-27.1: Make creative gives 24 paid-social ads, 12 under each audience's heading
F-27.2: New words on an ad of the second audience: the new words wait beside the four ads on those words only
Keep the new words: only those four ads are redrawn; the first audience's ads are untouched

specs.title: N-3 #1 and #5: an allow-listed email gets a link; opening it uses nothing; Continue signs in once; then it has expired
N-3 #2 and #3, N-2 #4 and #5: an invitee signs out, signs back in by email to their own workspace, and once revoked gets nothing
N-3 #6: a header-injection or over-long address is refused on the page, with no reply
the console mailer route answers off Vercel only, and tells nothing beyond its own outbox
S4-1 #1-#3, S4-2 and S4-4: sign-off through the inbox, with personas and a test plan
the inbox says when nothing is waiting, or lists what is
C7-1 #1, #2, #5, #7: Sizes on a social ad and a display ad, every size listed with its checks and drawn full size

steps.title: Write a Fernhollow Outfitters brief with the mock Brief agent
Add display to the brief's channels and sign version 2 off
Make creative: 12 paid-social and 12 display ads (simulated pictures)
C7-1.1: open Sizes on a paid-social ad: the four social sizes, each with contrast, fit, legal lines and the simulated label
Every social size is drawn at its full size, and the 9:16 story opens full size in a new tab
C7-1.7: an unknown size, or a banner size of a social ad, is not found
C7-1.2 and C7-1.5: open Sizes on a display ad: the three banners, each drawn with its checks and the simulated label

specs.title: C7-1 #4: a size the legal lines don't fit is left out with the reason, and the other sizes still draw

steps.title: Write a Quillmoor Money brief with the mock Brief agent
Add display to the brief's channels and sign version 2 off
Make creative: 12 paid-social and 12 display ads (simulated pictures)
C7-1.4: Sizes on a Quillmoor display ad: its three legal lines don't fit the 728 × 90 leaderboard, so it is left out with the reason
The medium rectangle and the half page still draw, with their checks

specs.title: F-3 #1: signed out, / is the welcome page with no app data, and app routes go to sign-in
F-3 #2 and #3: an invite signs someone in once, to their own workspace, until it is revoked
F-18a: New sign-in link sits beside Revoke, and its link opens below the row without moving them
